title: Layer 2 round 1 major security: unbounded, untimed subprocess capture at both chassis and git boundaries
description: acquire.rs:89 and refs.rs:26 use Command::output with no output cap and no timeout, while every FILE read in the crate rides the 1 MiB bounded-read discipline (#732) — an inconsistency a hostile or wedged subprocess exploits (unbounded stdout materialization; an indefinitely-hanging child blocks status forever). Disposition: cap subprocess stdout and impose a wall-clock timeout, mapping breach to the unusable outcome; align the posture with the bounded-read rule. Owner: security. Validator: software-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: subprocess.rs runs every child bounded and timed — stdout capped at the shared artifact bound (one documented bound for materialization), stderr at 4KiB, a 10s wall-clock deadline with kill, reader threads so a chatty child cannot wedge a full pipe. Both crosslink acquisition arms and the git ref listing ride it. PATH-resolution posture documented as operator-environment trust, out of model.
